label: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy improves clinical symptoms and functional capacity and modulates thalamic connectivity in ME/CFS: a prospective cohort study.
summary: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) has been proposed as a treatment for myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS), but evidence remains limited. This study evaluated its clinical effectiveness and feasibility, as well as associated functional brain changes. Thirty patients with ME/CFS (mean age 42.3 ± 11.7 years; 7 males, 23 females) received 40 HBOT sessions. Clinical outcomes were assessed at baseline, during treatment, and four weeks post-treatment.
